verdict.rationale: Mercury documents issuing business debit/credit cards to employees with spend limits and granular permissions (mercury-docs-10, mercury-docs-27, mercury-docs-38, mercury-docs-1), and a community user confirms creating many cards with individual limits (mercury-comm-1). However most product copy emphasizes virtual cards (mercury-docs-2) and no evidence explicitly details a physical-card issuance workflow tied to defined employee roles. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of physical card ordering/shipping process, and role-based (not just limit-based) card issuance controls.
